source.verification: current-user navigation control opens the existing About Build read surface

laravel_adaptation.authorization_contract: trusted FrontendContext + active tenant membership + tenant.view; destination independently enforces web + auth + tenant.context and TenantAuthorizer tenant.view with exact tenant-slug match
laravel_adaptation.fail_closed_behavior: control is absent when the user identity, authoritative active-tenant membership, tenant.view permission, or user-chip runtime mount is unavailable; direct foreign-tenant navigation is rejected by the backend

runtime_path: TenantBootstrap obtains FrontendContext from /tenants/{tenantSlug}/context and renders no authenticated workspace controls when that authoritative request fails
CurrentUserSiteDetailsControl is the current-user chip composition and mounts CurrentUserAboutBuildControl into .user-chip
CurrentUserAboutBuildControl requires a positive server-derived user id, active tenant present in the server-provided tenant membership list, and tenant.view or wildcard permission

destination is derived only from FrontendContext.tenant.slug through tenantUrl and fixed /about-build; browser pathname, query parameters, resource IDs and caller-supplied tenant selectors are ignored
GET /tenants/{tenant}/about-build is registered under web + auth + tenant.context
AboutBuildReadController re-authorizes tenant.view and aborts with 404 unless TenantContext tenant slug exactly matches the route tenant
BuildInformationReadService returns a fixed allowlist of build metadata; application secrets and arbitrary configuration are not serialized
selected operation is read-only navigation: no write payload, persistence mutation, CSRF write, idempotency token, retry queue, cancellation lifecycle, or success toast exists

security_boundary.auth_session: frontend context and destination are both protected by authenticated Laravel session boundaries; guest direct navigation redirects to login
security_boundary.active_tenant_resolution: navigation is derived from the server-provided FrontendContext active tenant; backend TenantContext independently resolves active membership
security_boundary.permission_checks: control fails closed without tenant.view or wildcard; AboutBuildReadController independently authorizes tenant.view
security_boundary.foreign_tenant_rejection: focused acceptance proves an authenticated alpha member receives 404 for /tenants/foreign/about-build
security_boundary.direct_id_rejection: not applicable: selected control accepts no resource ID; focused frontend test proves browser path/query input cannot select the destination tenant
security_boundary.validation: no user payload exists; tenant slug is URL-encoded client-side and independently matched against server TenantContext
security_boundary.csrf: not applicable to the selected GET/read-only navigation; no state-changing request is issued
security_boundary.server_derived_identity_and_ownership: user id, tenant membership list, active tenant and permissions come from authenticated server FrontendContext; the control has no identity or ownership input fields
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: focused HTTP acceptance plants a secret sentinel in application configuration and proves it is absent from rendered About Build output; build service exposes only whitelisted build metadata
security_boundary.authoritative_persistence_reread: not applicable because the operation performs no mutation and makes no persisted-success claim
security_boundary.idempotency_retry_cancellation: repeated GET navigation is inherently read-only and focused acceptance verifies it does not create tenant membership state; there is no retry queue or cancellable mutation
security_boundary.truthful_success: the control does not synthesize a success state; build information is rendered only by the protected server route from BuildInformationReadService
security_boundary.fail_closed: missing authenticated context, valid server-derived identity, active tenant membership, permission or backend tenant match removes/rejects access instead of fabricating an About Build result

acceptance_tests: current-user-about-build-control.test.tsx exact marker, active-tenant derivation, URL encoding, browser-path/query rejection, permission/membership/identity fail-closed and wildcard authorization

canonical_denominator_contribution.scope_note: Expected one-operation delta only; official generator and exact-head gates remain authoritative.

scope_exclusions: no new About Build backend route or duplicate route operation
no caller-supplied tenant destination or direct object identifier
no permission weakening or endpoint bypass
no persistence mutation or fabricated success
